phases.description: Discovery phase inserted ahead of implementation per operator directive (2026-08-01). ROOT INFO ALREADY EXISTS — do not re-derive it. This WO is GX-002's successor in the Core Improvements 731 program; the program root is coderef/working/coderef-core/core-improvements-731/PLAN.md and two /discover reports in that same folder already characterize this exact question at depth medium and thorough. This phase reads that evidence, re-measures against live numbers, and reconciles the WO's stated scope before any code is touched. It exists because the WO's headline premise is known to be stale: PLAN.md cites 62% / 10,691 edges failing on receiver_not_in_symbol_table, while discovery-resolution-core-issue.md (2026-08-01T08:18Z) measured that class at 7,739 and found 94.8% of ALL unresolved edges (17,301 of 18,249) live in test files as vitest ambient globals and expect()-matcher chains — a denominator artifact no symbol-table resolver can resolve. The engine's own candidate ranking for this WO is separately unusable: it ranked dist-old/src/pipeline/scope-binding.{d.ts,js}, which are stale build artifacts, not source.

tasks.description: Read the 731 program root and its two existing discovery reports IN FULL before anything else. PLAN.md gives the GX-002..GX-005 program framing and the original 62% claim. discovery-resolution-core-issue.md (depth=medium) carries the denominator-artifact finding and REC-R1..R4. discovery-edge-resolution-program.md (depth=thorough) carries the lever disposition and names the real post-reclassify frontier: FU-2 dotted-chain receiver field-path walking at ~5,050 edges (size L) and FU-3 heritage-aware own-method lookup (size M). Do NOT re-run /discover on this question — it has been run twice and the artifacts are on disk.

Re-measure the live unresolved population so this WO works against current numbers rather than PLAN.md's. Read .coderef/validation-report.json for resolution_rate, unresolved, unresolved_src_count, ambiguous, ambiguous_src, builtin, external, provisional. Then facet the unresolved_edges surface by reason (receiver_not_in_symbol_table vs callee_not_in_symbol_table) and by file (*.test.* vs src). Record the drift: the two discovery runs 55 minutes apart already moved unresolved 18,249 -> 18,527 and unresolved_src 948 -> 959, so a third reading is expected to differ again. What matters is the src-scoped figure, not the headline.

Discard the engine-generated candidate set and establish the real defect sites by reading them. The generated list named 25 candidates including dist-old/src/pipeline/scope-binding.d.ts and dist-old/src/pipeline/scope-binding.js — compiled output under dist-old/, which is not source and must never be edited. The genuine surfaces named by the thorough discovery are src/pipeline/scope-binding.ts (where GX-002 shipped the scope-stack pass for +14 edges), src/pipeline/call-resolver.ts (home of the P3c js_prototype_member reclassify precedent), and src/pipeline/edge-confidence.ts plus the field-index surface for the FU-2 dotted-receiver lever. Read them and confirm which actually carries the work this WO describes.

Resolve the sequencing question this WO cannot answer for itself. REC-R1 (test_dsl reclassify of ambient callees and expect()-rooted matcher receivers) is a disposition change requiring an operator ruling in the P3c shape — it changes zero graph edges but removes ~95% of the denominator. REC-R3 states plainly that the resolver levers should be sequenced AFTER that reclassify so their yield is measured against an honest denominator. Determine whether this WO's factory-returns-and-chained-calls work is (a) the FU-2 lever, which REC-R3 sequences after REC-R1, (b) genuinely independent of the denominator question, or (c) a restatement of work GX-002 already shipped. State which, with evidence.

Write the reconciled scope into analysis.json, which is currently an empty skeleton (empty blast_radius, risks, candidates, decision_records). Populate: the real defect sites from P1-T3 with the dist-old/ candidates explicitly listed as ruled out and why; the live measurements from P1-T2 as the baseline this WO will be judged against; blast_radius from the actual dependents; a decision record for the P1-T4 sequencing verdict; and a risk entry for the measurement trap — that any yield reported against the raw 18k denominator will read as ~0.1pp regardless of real effect, exactly as GX-002's +106 resolved edges did.
Commit the discovery phase — analysis.json and plan.json only, no source. Route through the guarded runner with explicit --paths; never git add -A in the shared checkout.

HALT and report before Phase 2. Phase 2 as written implements against the original 62% premise. If P1-T4 concluded (a) or (c), that premise no longer holds and Phase 2's goal must be restated or the WO folded into the REC-R1 sequence — either is an operator ruling, not an executor decision. Surface the reconciled scope, the live numbers, and the sequencing verdict, then wait.
